title: ihWarp
subtitle: IH Webpack Assets Replicator Plugin (ihWARP)
tagline: A webpack plugin that copies assets referenced in HTML files into the output directory.
overview: Webpack plugin for copying assets referenced in HTML files. This plugin scans through Webpack's output assets for HTML files, extracts asset references (from src, href, meta tags, etc.), and copies the referenced asset files from specified directories (assetPaths) into the Webpack output directory. Files can be excluded from processing via exceptHTML (for HTML files) and exceptAssets (for asset paths). Additionally, if the asset file's extension is listed in mapExtensions, a corresponding .map file will also be copied.
optionsDescription: Configuration options available for the ihWARP plugin.

options.name: assetPaths
options.description: Array of directory/directories where the asset files are searched.

options.name: exceptHTML
options.description: Array of HTML file paths (relative to output) to be excluded from processing.

options.name: exceptAssets
options.description: Array of asset paths or filenames to be omitted from processing.

options.name: mapExtensions
options.description: Array of file extensions for which associated .map files are copied.

options.name: verbose
options.description: Enables detailed logging output in the console during the Webpack build.
